title: A barbershop booking bot: services, masters, slots, cancellation, reminders
lead: Clients pick a service, a master, a day and a time themselves; taken slots are blocked, with cancellation, reminders and a bookings table for the admin.

hero.caption: Bot page: the booking chat on a phone next to the offer, with service prices and reminders.
hero.alt: Bot page: the booking chat on a phone next to the offer, with service prices and reminders.

problem: A barbershop wants clients to book themselves: choose a service, a master, a day and a time, get a confirmation, and be reminded a day and two hours before. The admin needs to be told about each booking and to see all of them in a table.
built: Booking with buttons from service to confirmation; the scenario runs on a page in the browser.
Times that are taken or already past cannot be chosen; cancelling a booking frees the slot.
The admin gets a notification and sees all bookings in one table.
For your salon the scenario connects to the channel your clients use: we agree how in the brief.

shots.caption: A finished booking on a phone: reminders 24 h and 2 h before, with a cancel button.
shots.alt: A finished booking on a phone: reminders 24 h and 2 h before, with a cancel button.

steps: The client picks a service, a master, a day and a time with buttons.
Reminders go out a day and two hours before the visit.
Cancelling frees the slot; the admin is notified and sees the booking in a table.
stack: Booking page in the browser (HTML, CSS, JavaScript)
offer: A booking bot for your salon, studio or solo master: services, masters, working hours.
Reminders, cancellation and an admin notification.
Connection to your clients’ channel — agreed in the brief.
not_included: CRM integration — quoted separately once I see which CRM you use.
